review:
Moleionaire is a 7x7 garden cluster slot with fruits, vegetables, flowers and butterflies, where clusters of five matching symbols pay. Before each spin, two symbols are chosen at random as a React Pair and turn into wilds when they land next to each other.

Four to seven scatters award 8 to 14 free spins, during which multipliers from the React Pair are applied to the total win, and extra scatters retrigger more spins. Pragmatic Play advertises a 5,000x maximum. The RTP is 96.5%. The React Pair gives each spin a small puzzle to watch for.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
